CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
No. 3514.

SHANGHAI, 13 October 1936.

Sir,

With reference to your letter of
the 9th September 1936 No.D.7517, I
have the honour to inform you that Miss
Chrisje de Vries has been married to
Mr.William George Dray at Hongkong on
the 5th October 1936.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
Chinese Secretary.

T.Robertson,Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

FILE
〔手写批注：2/2 14/10〕

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / 14 OCT. 1936 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No REGISTRY / S. B. D. 7517 / Special Branch - / S2 Station,）
REPORT
Date August 29, 1936.

Subject Communication dated August 26, 1936 from the Netherlands
Consulate-General regarding a Miss Chrisje de VRIES.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by J Logan E.S.I.

Miss Chrisje de VRIES arrived in Shanghai on
November 12, 1935 from London on the N.Y.K. s.s. "Hakusan
Maru" and declared herself to be a Netherlands subject in
possession of Netherlands passport No. 449050 issued at
Leyden on February 4, 1932.

Immediately after her arrival she resided at
Norfolk House, No. 6 - 10, Lane 20, Seymour Road, being
known as Mrs. Dray. She has been living with Dray ever since
and is generally regarded as being his wife.

Dray is the master of the s.s. "Rosalie Moller"
now under charter to the M.B.K. Line, and from March until
mid-July of this year, Miss de Vries was making occasional
voyages on this ship with him.

She is at present reported to be residing in
Hongkong and any mail matter addressed to:-

Mrs. C. de V. Dray,
c/o Capt. W.G. Dray,
"Rosalie Moller,"
Moller Line,
Hongkong,

will be forwarded to her.

Enquiries show that no marriage has been consum-
mated in Shanghai between Captain Dray and Miss de Vries.

（批：28B. / 3/8.）

D.S. Pitts.
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner (Crime & Special Branches).

报告
日期：1936年8月29日。

事由：荷兰总领事馆1936年8月26日来函，涉及Chrisje de VRIES小姐。

制作人：D.S. Pitts。转呈人：J Logan 高级警佐

Chrisje de VRIES小姐于1935年11月12日乘日本邮船会社“白山丸”号轮船从伦敦抵达上海，并申报其为荷兰籍公民，持有1932年2月4日在莱顿签发的第449050号荷兰护照。

抵沪后，她随即居住在西摩路20弄6-10号诺福克大楼，对外称Dray太太。此后一直与Dray同居，通常被视为其妻子。

Dray是“Rosalie Moller”号轮船的船长，该船目前租予M.B.K.轮船公司。今年3月至7月中旬期间，de Vries小姐曾偶尔随他乘坐该船航行。

据报她目前居住在香港，凡寄往以下地址的邮件：

C. de V. Dray 太太，
转 W.G. Dray 船长，
“Rosalie Moller”号，
Moller 轮船公司，
香港，

均将转交给她。

经查，Dray船长与de Vries小姐在上海并未举行婚礼。

（批：28B. / 3/8.）

D.S. Pitts。
D. S.

副警务处长（刑事及特别处）。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3009.                                SHANGHAI,        26th August 1936.

〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写编号 S. D. 7517 等〕

Sir,

    I have the honour to inform you that in March of
this year Miss Chrisje de Vries, of Netherlands nationa-
lity, at that time residing at 6 Seymour Road, informed
me of her intended marriage to the British subject, Wil-
liam George Dray.

    Since a letter sent to Miss de Vries at the above
address was returned by the post office, I venture to
enquire whether this person is still residing at Shanghai.

    I may add that according to information received
from the local British Consulate-General no record exists
of any marriage between said woman and Mr. Dray.

                                    I have the honour to be,
                                                Sir,
                                    Your obedient servant,
                                    〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕
                                    Chinese Secretary.

T. Robertson, Esquire,
    Deputy Commissioner i/c Special Branch,
        Shanghai Municipal Police,
                    SHANGHAI.

〔此处转录不清：左下角多处手写批注及日期〕

〔印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (CRIME BRANCH)〕

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。

第 3009 号。                                上海，        1936年8月26日。

〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写编号 S. D. 7517 等〕

先生：

    谨此奉告，今年三月，当时居住在西摩路6号的荷兰籍公民Chrisje de Vries小姐告知我，她打算与英国公民William George Dray结婚。

    由于寄往上述地址给de Vries小姐的一封信件被邮局退回，故冒昧查询此人是否仍居住在上海。

    另据从本地英国总领事馆获得的信息，该女子与Dray先生之间并无任何婚姻记录。

                                    此致
                                                敬礼
                                    〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕
                                    中文秘书。

T. Robertson 先生，
    副警务处长兼特别处主管，
        上海公共租界工部局警务处，
                    上海。

〔此处转录不清：左下角多处手写批注及日期〕

〔印：副警务处长（刑事处）〕
